conversion_policy: Prices, sizes and timestamps are exact; nothing is rounded. Source publisher and instrument IDs are kept; the channel is the source channel_id, or 0 when the file has none. NWT sequences restart at 1 per (publisher, channel); the source sequence number is not carried. Source flags are not carried. Every row -> BOOK_SNAPSHOT with the row's 10 levels and the depth-limited flag set. Trailing levels that are empty on both sides are dropped. A row with an empty level above a filled one, or with bid or ask prices out of order, stops the conversion. Trade rows restate the book; the trade print itself is not carried by this kind. Each instrument's definition comes from the venue's definition file and is written before its first record.
